'''Abryl''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed in [[Kaas City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]&mdash;center of the Sith Empire. Working as a [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]] of special items, he wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] underneath his [[Robe/Legends|robes]] and a mask covering his face, and also carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Abryl appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="TOR" /> They appear in the marketplace of [[Kaas City]] as a Legacy items vendor.<ref name="TOR" />
